items.html: And it is now found that the four lower [Sefirot] of Beria and the entire world of Yetzira and Assiya are empty — being the place of twenty-four Sefirot — and all this place was then vacant, empty, and hollow, and was in the secret of the Shabbat boundary, which is two thousand cubits, as is known. Except for the fourteen lower Sefirot, where there was a permanent dwelling for the Klipot, as above. And the ten other upper Sefirot were the secret of the Shabbat boundary.
